sources.title: Illustrative FPV scene
sources.method: Built-in image_gen, guided by the previously approved room view.
sources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is a previous README composition. Use ONLY the room visible inside its left-hand app window as the visual reference.
Deliver a standalone clean 16:9 FPV camera scene of that same room: camera at a tiny RC car's height, just above the wooden floor, looking between the wooden chair legs toward the sofa, potted plants, curtains and soft window light. Preserve the warm wood, ordinary realistic room, toy-camera low perspective, and recognizable placement of chair legs from the reference.
Output ONLY the camera view, full bleed, at 1600x900 or a comparable 16:9 resolution. Remove all HUD elements: no crosshair, no throttle bar, no steering tape, no recording text, no numbers, no titlebar, no text at all. No device hardware, no visible car, no page background, no typography, no borders, no watermark. Natural photographic texture, restrained color, mildly imperfect consumer FPV camera image, no cinematic lighting or glossy advertising finish.

sources.title: Driver HUD over illustrative scene
sources.method: Captured from mpv using the HUD renderer in drive.mjs. An isolated scratch copy substituted the still image for the demo test pattern and set demo state to 35% throttle, -10% steering, trim 0, recording, and 25 FPS. App source is unchanged. This is not live car footage.

sources.title: Approved steering-wheel/controller logo
sources.method: Built-in image_gen in generation mode; approved after review in Preview. The original transparent source.png is fitted proportionally to a square canvas and shared with the native app icons. The composition preserves its shape and colors.
